offers_products.reason: Sells software products: QuickBooks, TurboTax, Mailchimp, Credit Karma platform, Intuit Enterprise Suite as SaaS.

offers_services.reason: Offers TurboTax expert tax preparation services, Intuit Experts bookkeeping help, payments and lending services alongside software.

sells_to_consumers.reason: TurboTax and Credit Karma are sold directly to individuals and households for taxes and personal finance.

sells_to_organizations.reason: QuickBooks, Mailchimp and Enterprise Suite serve small businesses; accounting firms use ProConnect and firm tools.

recurring_revenue.reason: QuickBooks Online and Mailchimp are subscriptions; though TurboTax is seasonal annual, it is repeat purchasing by returning users.

cyclical_demand.reason: Tax filing and bookkeeping software are necessary, low-cost, mandatory-driven; Mailchimp marketing is more discretionary but smaller.

big_ticket.reason: Subscriptions and annual tax filing fees are small, frequent purchases for buyers.

people_delivered.reason: Revenue comes mainly from software platforms like QuickBooks and TurboTax, not staff time; experts are an add-on.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are consumers and small businesses, plus accountants; not large enterprises or government.

asset_heavy.reason: Software and cloud platform business; growth needs engineering and marketing, not plants, fleets or properties.
